pages.text: [#](53341a)Mutandis is the old hedge-breaking powder, scattered over living growth to force a plant into some stranger relation — one of the first ways a witch steps outside ordinary farming.[#]()
pages.title: Mutandis

pages.text: [#](53341a)It can be compounded by hand, or brewed in the **Witch's Cauldron** by the older path.[#]()
[#](53341a)Compound eight portions from **Wood Ash**, **Hint of Rebirth**, a **Mandrake Root**, an **Egg**, **Bone Meal**, and **Green Dye**.[#]()
[#](53341a)The original path also works: heat and fill the **Witch's Cauldron**, drop in a **Mandrake Root** and an **Egg**, then right-click with **Exhale of the Horned One** for six portions.[#]()
pages.title: Cauldron Path

pages.text: [#](53341a)Drop **Nether Wart** in and right-click with Mutandis to condense one **Mutandis Extremis**.[#]()

[#](53341a)Use Mutandis on natural plants or saplings. It can roll Witchery plants and saplings, **Alder** and **Hawthorn Saplings**, vanilla saplings, flowers, fern, grass, dead bush, and the small bush.[#]()

[#](53341a)In the Spirit World it can also reveal Nether Wart.[#]()
pages.title: Hedge Mutations

pages.text: [#](53341a)It is a mutating powder, not a fertilizer — expect transformation, not growth.[#]()
[#](53341a)Surround a **Nether Wart** with eight ordinary Mutandis for eight portions — or use the cauldron path above.[#]()

[#](53341a)Extremis pushes the art further: it mutates crops as well as wild growth, flips grass and dirt, and turns sand under water or ice into clay.[#]()

[#](53341a)It is also the bridge into heavier progressions like Treefyd Seeds.[#]()
pages.title: Extremis

pages.text: [#](53341a)Treat it as the serious version of hedgecraft.[#]()
